text:
Ivy: small thread  new pricing experiment before the webinar: test descriptive plan labels + estimator + compact FAQ to improve conversion.
Marco: love it. what's the main call to action change?
Ivy: primary CTA = 'Start free trial', secondary = 'Talk to sales'. We want the trial CTA to surface per-plan estimated cost inline.
Tess: labeling test variants: V1 generic (Core / Pro / Enterprise), V2 descriptive (Lift / Flow / Secure), V3 persona-led (Developer / Product / Platform). pick 2 for A/B.
Rohan: recommend descriptive vs persona-led. also ensure mapping to SKUs is documented.
NotifBot: heads up  I'll post to #marketing-updates when experiment launches with tags experiment=pricing_compact_may26.
Claire: hubspot mapping note: add hidden `experiment=pricing_compact_may26` and `lead_bucket=webinar`. SalesOps wants `notify=sales-eng@redwood.com`.
Ivy: estimator options: inline slider for tokens + select for expected sessions -> returns ballpark monthly. client-only. keep keyboard accessible.
Marco: metrics: trial CTA click-thru, demo form conversions, revenue-weighted MQLs. segment by org_size and region.
Tess: micro-FAQ questions: "How am I billed?", "Can I reserve capacity?", "Is my data isolated?" answers collapsed with 'expand' affordance.
Rohan: timeline: copy finalize today, dev tomorrow, QA Friday, soft-launch Saturday 20% traffic, monitor over weekend, full launch Monday.
Ivy: ACTIONS: Ivy final copy + choose 2 label sets (today), Marco implement analytics events, Tess build micro-FAQ HTML/CSS, Rohan dev estimator, Claire map HubSpot fields.
NotifBot: I'll trigger a nightly summary of experiment metrics to #marketing-ops.
Ivy: if no objections i'll push copy to staging tonight. :rocket:
